newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yen sales in crosses lift dollar vs yen in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Yen sales in crosses lift dollar vs yen in Tokyo.

text.p: *Dollar edged up against yen in mid-afternoon Tokyo trade on Tuesday due to yen sales against sterling and mark.
*Short-covering interest strong as dollar firmly supported above 117 yen in morning.
*Dollar also supported by Japanese trust banks' eagerness to buy greenback.
*Stop-loss buy orders for mark/yen lined up around 64.10-64.30.

*"Speculators may test the mark up above 64 yen where stop-loss buy orders are placed. The dollar/yen could rise sharply if those stop-loss orders (for mark/yen) are triggered," a Japanese city bank dealer said.
*At 0527 GMT, mark stood at 63.94/96 yen compared with 63.79 yen at midday. Sterling was at 191.70 yen against 191.31 yen at midday.
*Dollar sentiment remained strong despite earlier falls on constant sales by Japanese exporters during Tokyo dealing today.
*Dollar consolidating above 117 yen by midday Tokyo after earlier falling on long liquidation.
*Dollar pared overnight gains but its undertone still bullish against yen and mark.
*U.S. operators and Japanese investors said to be keen to pick up dollars against yen on downside.
